infra.ask.chooseCurrentHint: Appends to the open session's composer instead of overwriting what you typed.
infra.ask.chooseNewHint: Creates a session in awog-infra (the separate infra folder) and puts the content there.
infra.ask.copiedInstead: Could not open a new session — copied to the clipboard instead
infra.ask.copyFailed: Could not copy to the clipboard
infra.ask.done: Added to the open session's message box
infra.ask.doneNew: Opened a new infra session and put the content in its composer
infra.ask.noSession: No session is open — copied to the clipboard instead of sending
